data.polymarket_dataset module¶

Polymarket Dataset Module. Handles loading and processing of multivariate time-series data from Polymarket events.

class data.polymarket_dataset.PolymarketDataset(name, dataset_dir, seq_len, pred_len, download=False, transform=None)[source]¶

Bases: Dataset

Dataset class for Polymarket prediction data (Multivariate). Loads multiple candidate files and aligns them by timestamp.

data.time_series_dataset module¶

Time Series Dataset for sliding window training.

Loads CSV data and creates (X, Y) pairs for supervised learning.

class data.time_series_dataset.TimeSeriesDataset(csv_path: str, target_column: str, seq_len: int = 30, pred_len: int = 1, train: bool = True, train_ratio: float = 0.8, normalize: Literal['minmax', 'zscore'] | None = 'minmax', stats: dict | None = None)[source]¶

Bases: Dataset

Dataset for time series forecasting with sliding windows.

Parameters:

  • csv_path – Path to CSV file.

  • target_column – Column name to predict.

  • seq_len – Length of input sequence (lookback).

  • pred_len – Length of prediction horizon.

  • train – Whether this is training split.

  • train_ratio – Ratio of data for training (rest is validation).

  • normalize – Normalization method (‘minmax’, ‘zscore’, or None).
